_comment: Hand-maintained overrides. Keys are RTP programme ids (pid) as strings. Re-check after each rebuild: new foreign acquisitions and international documentaries need adding, and RTP occasionally re-tags a programme so an entry here can become redundant.
_comment_page_notes: page_notes: the short, learner-facing label shown as a tag next to a title on the page and in the CSV's Note column. Keep it to a few words. `notes` above is the fuller, hand-written background and is not shown unless the pid also appears here.
_comment_confirmed_portuguese: confirmed_portuguese: titles a person (or the AI second pass, from RTP's credits) has confirmed are Portuguese productions, with the evidence. step05d_classify.py never asks about or flags these. Decision 0010.
